author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: cap_q captures raw pay_q (clk_a) either under synchronized v2_q or under the clk_b force_i bypass; the bypass arm makes the clock-enabled capture unsafe: CDC-028 ERROR. Reader A's CDC-013 note (vld_q 10 ns < 12 ns margin) is a valid extra finding on a bad case, not a flaw.

author_reading.rationale: Payload capture is enabled by a synchronized valid, but an else-if arm (force_i) also captures the raw source payload with no qualifier.

labels.rationale: With v2_q low and force_i high, cap_q samples asynchronous pay_q directly. The local force branch bypasses the synchronized valid for the enabled capture.
labels.suspected_flaw: The 10 ns valid launch period also falls below the 12 ns CDC-013 review margin.

labels.rationale: Unsynchronized 8-bit payload pay_q (clk_a) is captured into cap_q (clk_b) under synchronized qualifier v2_q at design.sv:27, but the else-if branch at design.sv:28 (else if (force_i) cap_q <= pay_q) enables raw cross-domain capture whenever destination input force_i is high and v2_q is low, bypassing synchronized qualification (CDC-028 ERROR Established).

settlement.rationale: cap_q captures raw pay_q (clk_a) either under synchronized v2_q or under the clk_b force_i bypass; the bypass arm makes the clock-enabled capture unsafe: CDC-028 ERROR. Reader A's CDC-013 note (vld_q 10 ns < 12 ns margin) is a valid extra finding on a bad case, not a flaw.
